title: kith-jmap: spawn-per-handler for panic isolation is correct
description: Every handler call is wrapped in tokio::task::spawn so a panic in a handler kills that task, not the connection handler task. A contributor might remove the spawn for simplicity. The spawn is load-bearing: without it, any handler panic unwinds through dispatch, through the axum handler, crashing the connection. The JoinError catch returning serverFail is the documented contract.
